name: Soulbound Eternity
source:
They say humanity has found a way to preserve their life. To live eternally through the works of an antique mythical mirror. Only for a small price, of course. A single human sacrifice must be held in  exchange for the supernatural. Take a peek at your sinned reflection, and eternal life is in your hands. 

Tales say that the Nocturne mansion is the one that holds this artifact. Though, you don't care. This myth is about as believable as the existence of the tooth fairy. You're a regular college student who's embarking on a trip to study the previously mentioned mansion for a research paper. However, it unfolds terribly when you're suddenly drawn towards a hidden room and shatter an important artifact - the so-called mirror itself! Desperate to keep your peaceful life, or at least not be charged, you have no choice but to fix it.

[From [url=https://kkuma-studio.itch.io/soulbound-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他们说人类已经找到了保存生命的方法。通过古老的神话镜子的作品永恒地生活。当然，只是为了一个很小的价格。必须用单一的活人祭品来换取超自然现象。看看你罪恶的倒影，永生就在你手中。

传说夜曲宅邸就是拥有这件神器的宅邸。虽然，你不在乎。这个神话与牙仙子的存在一样可信。你是一名普通的大学生，为了撰写研究论文而踏上研究前面提到的豪宅的旅程。然而，当你突然被一个隐藏的房间吸引并打碎一件重要的神器 - 所谓的镜子本身时，它就会变得可怕！迫切希望保持平静的生活，或者至少不被指控，你别无选择，只能解决它。

[来自[url=https://kkuma-studio.itch.io/soulbound-eternity]itch.io[/url]]
